summary: Deployed bundle-anatomy: index-Cg8FAMXN.js (2,280,438 B; live brotli 603,777 B) is 79.2% mapbox-gl 3.24.1 (1,806,133 B: shared 782,666 / worker 55,694 / main 966,763, plus two 838,974 B blob workers), 6.5% React 18.3.1 + react-dom + scheduler + zustand 4.5 (149,028 B), and only 14.2% app code (324,549 B), of which 46% (150,092 B) is inline data arrays (512 monuments = 111,003 B, 16 tour stops, NPS tour, etc.) and ~17% is CSS-in-JS. The app uses about five mapbox APIs (raster satellite style, NavigationControl, ~8 tiny GeoJSON sources / 13 line-symbol-circle layers, flyTo, project/unproject; units are drawn on the app's own canvas), ~24% of mapbox bytes (431 KB, excluding 177 KB shaders) belong to features it never uses, and the namespace `z_` is referenced only 5 times inside useEffect bodies, so mapbox can be split into a lazy chunk with a tiny patch; a statement-level cross-reference scan shows ENTRY/MAP/PANELS chunks with a small interface (7 + 29 + 13 names). Key runtime findings: first-visit SW controllerchange reload (redirects audit 9,066 ms; observed unthrottled FCP/LCP were only 287 ms, so lab FCP 4.1 s / LCP 9.0 s are mostly a JS-on-critical-path + reload artifact); CSS preload/onload swap + duplicate modulepreload + SW interception of /assets cause the 'cross-world service worker resource mismatch' warnings (CSS is requested twice on SW-controlled loads); a 3.5 s boot fast-forward that calls setState every frame with 26 whole-store subscribers and 0 selectors/memo; mobile creates TWO mapbox Map instances per visit and eagerly loads all 3 days of data; 38 boot fetches (37 unique, commander_successions twice; 598 KB raw, 138.6 KB wire) that merge to 81 KB br11 (-28%) and 6.4 KB br11 for Day-1 first paint; the same asset name index-Cg8FAMXN.js has served different bytes (Jul 20 vs Aug 22+), and the bundle is unchanged since Aug 22 with no editable source (N1; Jun-12 v25 source is a structural skeleton without any post-Jun feature). The report gives a byte-budgeted chunk map (entry <=180 KB raw/<=58 KB br; map chunk <=470 KB br for v3, ~240 KB for mapbox 2.15/MapLibre, ~50 KB for Leaflet-lite; panels lazy; data in <=3 hashed immutable JSON files), a map-engine option matrix with sizes/licences/prices (mapbox-gl 3.24.1 1.80 MB vs 2.15.0 986 KB vs MapLibre 5.6.0 939 KB vs Leaflet 148 KB; Mapbox ToS licence; 50k free map loads/$5 per 1k; Raster Tiles 750k free), the proposed waterfall, a phase-by-phase gain estimate (lab mobile after Phase 2: FCP 0.8-1.0 s, LCP 0.9-1.4 s, TBT 80-250 ms to verify, CLS <=0.03, Perf 92-99; warning that today's TBT 27 ms is an artifact that will worsen when FCP improves unless the long tasks are removed), and the dead-code list (no dead top-level app declarations; savings come from moving data and splitting).

findings.title: Kill the first-visit service-worker controllerchange reload (self-redirect, second full load)
findings.evidence: deploy/index.html:263-268 controllerchange->location.reload(); deploy/sw.js:17 skipWaiting(), :30 clients.claim(). lh_mobile.json redirects wastedMs 9066.55 (2nd document request at t=908 ms, 40,068 B, transfer 0); simulated LCP 9,007 ms vs observed LCP 287 ms; second load repeats 38 data fetches + tiles (rows t=1046-1442 ms).
findings.root_cause: New SW claims a page that is already fine on first install and the handler reloads unconditionally; guard is per-page-load so updated sw.js also reloads mid-session.
findings.fix: const hadController=!!navigator.serviceWorker.controller; on controllerchange return if !hadController; otherwise show a 'New version - Refresh' toast (never auto-reload during playback). Or drop skipWaiting/clients.claim so a new SW controls only the next navigation.
findings.acceptance_test: Playwright: clear storage, load /, wait 5 s: exactly 1 document request and 1 navigation entry; LH mobile redirects audit score 1.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Removes 9.07 s redirect penalty (lab LCP/TTI ~9.0/9.1 s -> ~4-5 s before other fixes); RUM first-visit FCP/LCP/INP
findings.correction: Evidence and fix are correct (index.html:264-267, sw.js:17/:30, LH second document at 909 ms with 38 repeated data fetches). Caveats: the '~4-5 s post-fix simulated LCP' is a guess (LH's own redirects.metricSavings claims -9,050 ms for both LCP and FCP, larger than FCP itself); the '45% of page loads are first visits' divides all-site pageviews by uniques and is only an upper bound (home page 1,713 pageviews; SW registered only from /).

findings.title: Remove CSS preload/onload swap + duplicate modulepreload; stop SW intercepting /assets (source of 'cross-world service worker resource mismatch' warnings)
findings.evidence: deploy/index.html:55-58 (modulepreload of entry JS; rel=preload as=style crossorigin onload->rel=stylesheet) + :282 module script; sw.js:41-50 respondWith cache-first for /assets/*. LH second (SW-controlled) load requests index-B4G7Z_2G.css twice (t=1046 and 1050 ms, 40,827 B) vs once on first load. index CSS is byte-identical to mapbox-gl.css (only global CSS; app uses inline styles). Chromium message text per vite-pwa issue #945: 'A preload for X is found, but is not used because it is a cross-world service worker resource mismatch'.
findings.root_cause: Hand-written preload hints under /assets/ combined with a SW that controls the page (and clients.claim() changing controller mid-load) and an onload rel flip that re-issues the request; the entry JS is already discovered by the module script.
findings.fix: Delete both hints; load mapbox-gl.css as a dependency of the lazy map chunk (Vite preload helper rT already in bundle at bundle.pretty.js:9065 accepts CSS deps) or a plain <link rel=stylesheet>; stop the SW handling /assets/*; keep no <noscript> CSS (app needs JS).
findings.acceptance_test: DevTools console shows zero preload/cross-world messages on cold, warm and SW-controlled loads; one request per CSS/entry JS per load.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Best Practices console-clean; one fewer 40 KB duplicate fetch; removes FCP-graph dependency
findings.correction: Real: hints at index.html:55-58 and duplicate CSS request in the SW-controlled load (t=1046 and t=1051, not 1050). The deployed CSS is byte-identical to Vite's minified dist/assets/mapbox-B4G7Z_2G.css (md5 8e7defef...), NOT to npm mapbox-gl.css (40,806 B, md5 b99a6c72...). vite-pwa#945 documents the cross-world message for modulePreload JS chunks, not preload as=style, so the CSS mapping is inference. Deleting the inline onload= handler also removes a CSP unsafe-inline dependency. Fix direction is sound.

findings.title: Rewrite sw.js: versioned cache, no cache poisoning, no stale manifest, no useless navigation interception
findings.evidence: sw.js:3 constant CACHE_NAME gbg-v5; :5-13 hardcoded hashed names + /manifest.json cached cache-first forever (:53-54); :43-47 caches any response with no res.ok check; :28 deletes only differently-named caches so old hashed assets accumulate; navigations fall to fetch().catch(caches.match) but HTML is never put, so offline gives a network error.
findings.root_cause: Hand-maintained SW without a build-time manifest.
findings.fix: Generate precache manifest at build (Workbox injectManifest / vite-plugin-pwa), name cache from manifest hash, require res.ok && type basic before put, do not intercept /assets/* (HTTP immutable already), manifest.json network-first (else E1 orientation fix never reaches installs), navigationPreload or no navigation handling, /data/* stale-while-revalidate by hashed name.
findings.acceptance_test: Playwright deploy v1 then v2: caches.keys() has only new cache; injected 500 not cached; changed manifest.json seen on next load.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Reliability, repeat-visit correctness, storage bloat
findings.correction: All sw.js line cites verified. Resolve the tension between fix items (1) precache manifest and (4) do not intercept /assets/*: precache routes must still serve /assets from cache; only the runtime catch-all cache-first should go. No build exists for the frozen bundle, so a small Node script over the deploy dir replaces Workbox injectManifest. See missed issue 3 (cache.addAll goes through HTTP cache).

findings.title: Diet index.html: 23.7 KB inline scripts, render-blocking site-nav.js/css, 5 unused preconnects, crawler-only seo block
findings.evidence: index.html 39,638 B (br11 10,827; wire 13,556): inline scripts 23,721 B at L27,255,294,355,398,441,521,608 + 9,205 B inline CSS; setInterval x25 and querySelectorAll('body *') polling (L497-508); L279-280 site-nav.css/js blocking (LH render-blocking-insight 0.5); LH network-dependency-tree flags unused preconnects a.tiles, b.tiles, www.google.com, maps.googleapis.com, streetviewpixels (L43-44, 48-50); #seo-content L717-741 (1,809 B).

findings.acceptance_test: HTML <=14 KB raw/<=5 KB br; LH render-blocking-insight score 1; no unused preconnect; no setInterval in HTML; single h1.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: FCP -0.2-0.4 s lab; fewer main-thread scans; SEO/a11y
findings.correction: Byte figures verified (39,638 B HTML, 23,721 B inline script incl. 570 B JSON-LD, 9,205 B inline CSS, 3 h1). Wrong details: there are 3 setInterval calls (25/25/40 tries x 200 ms, bounded 5-8 s), not x25; onboardingVisible() runs once at 1.5 s (index.html:509-511), not as polling. 'site-nav.js lazy on first click' is not viable: index.html:285-291 buttons/pin/menu are empty shells filled by the L294-353 inline script from window.GTBG_MENU (site-nav.js:154). defer/type=module is safe (runs before DOMContentLoaded); lazy-on-click needs static button markup first.

findings.title: Build config when a real build exists: es2022 target, no modulepreload polyfill, manualChunks, source maps
findings.evidence: Optional chaining lowered to ==null?void 0 (65 sites, e.g. bundle.pretty.js:96867); modulepreload polyfill stmt 0 (710 B); LH valid-source-maps fails; zustand dev shims and 6 React licence banners present.
findings.fix: vite.config: build.target es2022, modulePreload.polyfill false, sourcemap true (public maps for entry/app), cssCodeSplit, manualChunks {react, mapbox}, hashed file names, esbuild.legalComments none + THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt.
findings.acceptance_test: LH unused-javascript and valid-source-maps pass for entry; no polyfill in HTML.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Best Practices valid-source-maps; -2-4 KB br
findings.correction: 65 lowered optional-chaining sites (60 in app), 710 B polyfill and 6 banners (1,492 B) verified, but 'es2022 target saves -2..4 KB br' is overstated: ~404 B raw for the 21 simplest sites, ~1-1.5 KB raw overall, ~0.3-0.6 KB br. The valid-source-maps acceptance only covers the entry chunk; a self-hosted 1.8 MB mapbox chunk would still fail it (see missed issue 2).

findings.title: Data-format scale plan for expanded databases (row JSON -> columnar -> typed-array binary + Worker)
findings.evidence: Deployed data = 694 placements + 1,110 density = 1,804 keyframes (placements_day1_ticks1_50 says record_count 4890, contains 100) vs placement_schema total ~430,000; Day 1 prototype: row JSON no-notes 86,733 B raw/6,440 B br11 vs columnar 25,668/5,374 vs binary struct 11,472/4,556; 430k rows would be ~63 MB row JSON.
findings.fix: Format-agnostic loader: row JSON (today) -> columnar with dictionaries (<=100k rows) -> typed-array binary per tick-range decoded in a Worker (>=100k rows); prose in separate files keyed by id; share schema/manifest with Historian ingestion.
findings.acceptance_test: Loader tests over 3 formats; synthetic 430k-row dataset loads <1 s off-main-thread and <5 MB wire.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Future-proofing INP/TBT at scale
findings.correction: 1,804 keyframes and the 4,890-vs-100 mismatch verified. The prototype binary struct <HHiiBHB is 16 B/record (717 x 16 = 11,472 B), so 430k rows = ~6.9 MB raw, not '~9 B/row => ~4 MB'. Compressed is ~6.4 B/row = ~2.7 MB, so the '<5 MB on the wire' acceptance still holds.

findings.title: Content-hash integrity: same asset URL served different bytes (Jul 20 vs Aug 22+) under immutable 1-year caching
findings.evidence: index-Cg8FAMXN.js 2,280,095 B md5 0903f96b... (Jul 20 zip) vs 2,280,438 B md5 7ef75b95... (Aug 22-Sep 29 zips); first diff at offset 151,648 (showUnits/toggleUnits added to store, bundle.pretty.js:9419-9437); netlify.toml /assets/* immutable max-age=31536000; sw.js:41-50 cache-first; sw.js:5-13 precaches fixed name.
findings.root_cause: Built file patched in place without re-hashing.
findings.fix: Deploy script recomputes sha256(content)[0:8], renames files and rewrites references (or deploy only Vite output); CI check hash(file)==name suffix; bump SW cache name once shipped.
findings.acceptance_test: CI fails on any assets/* name/content mismatch; a browser holding the Jul-20 file receives current bytes after the fix.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Caching correctness; prevents lazy chunks importing stale index exports
findings.correction: Evidence exact (Jul 20 md5 0903f96b... 2,280,095 B vs 7ef75b95... 2,280,438 B, offset 151,648, Jul 20 index.html references the same name). Bumping the SW cache name does NOT fix stale clients: sw.js:19 cache.addAll goes through the HTTP cache and /assets is immutable for a year, so a stale copy is re-precached. Only a hash rename (or cache:'reload') works; acceptance test must rely on the rename.

Data/animation specialists: do 1,804 keyframes plus the sticky forward-fill cache (bundle.pretty.js:96271) reproduce the intended 467-unit-per-tick view after arbitrary tick jumps, versus the ~430,000-record schema claim?
verification_summary: Verified all 13 critical/high and all 14 medium/low findings of bundle-anatomy (27 total). The measurements are very solid: every count, byte size, Lighthouse figure, compression number, library size, Mapbox price and licence quote I re-derived matched, most to the byte. Verdicts: 13 CONFIRMED, 14 CORRECTED, 0 REFUTED, 0 UNVERIFIABLE as a whole (a few sub-claims are flagged unverified inside individual verdicts, e.g. post-fix lab LCP of 4-5 s and the Lantern "High-priority script = FCP-blocking" mechanism). The main faults are in interpretation and fix design. (1) The "only five mapbox references / two Map constructors" claim is wrong: bundle.pretty.js has 8 `z_` references and 3 `new z_.Map`; the Virtual Walkthrough creates its own map at L110769-110770, so the proposed lazy-mapbox patch would throw ReferenceError there. Babel scope analysis confirms the mapbox statements' only entry-scope free variable is `gB` (= globalThis). (2) Finding 04's "site-nav.js lazy on first click" would blank the Extra Features/Historian buttons (index.html fills empty shells from window.GTBG_MENU); `defer` is safe. (3) Finding 10's notes split ignores that placement notes are consumed by the ancestor timeline and OOB/roster trees as well as the unit panel; finding 11's "mobile uses desktop's lazy day loading" would regress jump-to-day because desktop only loads Day 2/3 from the playback loop. (4) Overstated numbers: web-vitals attribution is ~4-5 KB br not ~2 KB (06); es2022 target saves ~0.3-0.6 KB br not 2-4 KB (19); binary format is 16 B/row not ~9 (24). (5) "Six sub-page maps need only basic APIs" is wrong: ground-remembers uses a heatmap layer, sandbox uses queryRenderedFeatures (16/18). (6) SW cache-name bump does not guarantee fresh bytes because cache.addAll goes through the immutable HTTP cache (27). Five MISSED items reported (1 high, 3 medium, 1 low). A "## Verification" section with the full verdict table was appended to plan-work/bundle-anatomy.md; scratch scripts are in plan-work/tmp-verify-bundle-anatomy/.

missed_by_specialist.title: Third Mapbox Map in the Virtual Walkthrough breaks the lazy-mapbox patch surface (findings 07/12/17)
missed_by_specialist.evidence: bundle.pretty.js:110769 `z_.accessToken = a2` and :110770 `M.current = new z_.Map({... style: "mapbox://styles/mapbox/satellite-v9", attributionControl: !1})` (:110777) inside _O's useEffect (:110768); layers at L110780-110830 with `text-font: ["Open Sans Bold", ...]` (:110811). grep of `\bz_\b` shows 8 references (97236, 97237, 97252, 102980, 102981, 110769, 110770 plus the L96208 definition), not the 5 claimed. The report's xref table lists z_ under PANELS->MAP.
missed_by_specialist.fix: Include the third effect in the loadMapbox() patch via a shared createMap(); decide whether the walkthrough reuses the main map's style/session or the main map is disposed/hidden while it is open (today desktop runs two live GL contexts); update the 'one satellite-v9 request per session' acceptance test; include the walkthrough's Open Sans Bold glyphs in the localFontFamily decision and check attribution requirements for its attributionControl:!1.

missed_by_specialist.title: valid-source-maps will still fail after the split because the self-hosted lazy mapbox chunk is >500 KiB first-party JS
missed_by_specialist.evidence: lh_mobile.json valid-source-maps flags index-Cg8FAMXN.js twice ('Large JavaScript file is missing a source map'); the report's own waterfall loads the ~1.8 MB mapbox chunk at ~1.6 s, inside the trace window. Finding 19's acceptance test only covers the entry chunk.
missed_by_specialist.fix: Publish a source map for the mapbox chunk (npm package ships dist/mapbox-gl.js.map; strip sourcesContent if the Mapbox licence is a concern) or keep the vendor chunk under 500 KiB (only true for Leaflet/MapLibre-lite); add the check to the Lighthouse CI assertions.

missed_by_specialist.title: SW precache re-fetches through the HTTP cache, so stale immutable bytes survive a cache-name bump
missed_by_specialist.evidence: sw.js:16-20 `caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then(cache => cache.addAll(PRECACHE_ASSETS))` uses default cache mode; netlify.toml serves /assets/* `public, max-age=31536000, immutable`; sw.js:6-7 precaches fixed names; Jul 20 vs Aug 22+ index-Cg8FAMXN.js differ in bytes under the same URL.
missed_by_specialist.fix: Build the precache from content-hashed URLs; for any unhashed precache entry (/manifest.json, icons, /favicon.ico) fetch with new Request(url, {cache:'reload'}); rename assets on content change rather than relying on the cache-name bump.

missed_by_specialist.title: Lazy/consolidated day loading regresses jump paths unless a store-level ensureDay() exists first
missed_by_specialist.evidence: zp at bundle.pretty.js:96900 is called only from sF (L96939), aF/lF (L96942-96946, invoked by Ed at L96991-96992 during playback) and mobile map load (L103040-103042). jumpToDay (L9369), keys 1/2/3 (L112987-112993), IO day buttons (jumpToDay at L112211) and bookmarks never load data. zp checks loadedDays only after the fetch completes (no in-flight dedupe) and marks a day loaded even if every file failed (.catch(() => ({placements: []}))).
missed_by_specialist.fix: Add ensureDay(day) with a per-day promise in the store, called from setTick/jumpToDay/scrubber/bookmarks before implementing findings 10/11 (mobile lazy loading, data consolidation, prefetch); do not mark a day loaded when all files fail. Coordinate with app-bugs E4/J1.

missed_by_specialist.title: CSP enforcement blockers (inline scripts and onload handler) are not tied to the load-path acceptance criteria
missed_by_specialist.evidence: index.html has 7 executable inline scripts (L255, 294, 355, 398, 441, 521, 608) and an inline onload= handler at L56-57; netlify.toml CSP is Report-Only with 'unsafe-inline' in script-src; Mapbox needs worker-src blob: unless the mapbox-gl-csp build is used.
missed_by_specialist.fix: Add 'no inline script or inline event handler remains' as an acceptance criterion of findings 02/04, then drop 'unsafe-inline' from script-src and enforce CSP; choose mapbox-gl-csp (finding 17) if worker-src blob: must go.
